Title: Diagnosis of test `testOptionGroupLong`

Details:
The test `testOptionGroupLong` is designed to verify that an `OptionGroup` correctly identifies the selected option when parsing command line options with long option names.

The test procedure:
- Creates an `OptionGroup` and adds two options with long option names "foo" and "bar".
- Adds this `OptionGroup` to an `Options` container.
- Parses the command line arguments `["--bar"]` using a `parser`.
- Asserts that the command line has option "bar" and the `OptionGroup`'s selected option is "bar".

Key points analyzed:
- The `OptionGroup` class has method `getSelected()` which simply returns the `selected` field.
- The `OptionGroup.addOption` method stores the option in an internal map keyed by `option.getKey()`.
- The `Option.getKey()` returns the long option name if the short one is null; so keys are the long option names here.
- The parser used is `PosixParser.parse(Options, String[])`.

The bug likely lies in how the parser (`PosixParser`) associates the selected option with the `OptionGroup`. Specifically, the `OptionGroup.selected` field is expected to be set to the key of the selected option ("bar" in this case). Since `OptionGroup.getSelected()` returns null or another incorrect value, it indicates that either the parser fails to mark the option as selected in the group when parsing long options, or the integration between `PosixParser` and `OptionGroup` is incomplete.

This suggests:
- The `PosixParser.parse` method is not calling the method in `OptionGroup` that sets the selected option correctly upon parsing a long option.
- Or `OptionGroup` lacks logic to update the selected field correctly when used with long options.

Fixing this requires inspecting the `PosixParser.parse` method's handling of option groups and ensuring it calls a method in `OptionGroup` to set the `selected` option properly, especially when parsing long options (`--bar`).

Best candidate methods for fixing:
- `org.apache.commons.cli.PosixParser.parse(org.apache.commons.cli.Options, java.lang.String[])`
- `org.apache.commons.cli.OptionGroup` (method that marks an option as selected)
- Possibly constructor or builder logic in `OptionBuilder` related to long options (less likely)

Final Suggestion:
Review and fix how `PosixParser` interacts with `OptionGroup` when a long option is parsed, to correctly update the group's selected option.
